The '''S7-H7 Slicing Droid''' was a model of [[Slicer droid/Legends|slicer droid]] that saw use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A number of S7-H7 droids worked with [[BB-22 Salvage Droid]]s and [[JT-65 Salvage Droid]]s in the [[Barasin Refuse Yards]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
S7-H7 Slicing Droids appear as enemies in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found in the Barasin Refuse Yards in the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
